query: How does VoyageFlow handle hotels and flights?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow supports two primary booking flows for hotels and flights [voyageflow-overview::002]. For hotels, VoyageFlow surfaces recommendations based on user preferences and generates deep booking links to partner platforms such as Booking.com, Expedia, and Agoda [voyageflow-overview::002]. Users complete the actual hotel booking on the partner site [voyageflow-overview::002]. For flights, VoyageFlow generates flight search links pre-filled with origin, destination, and dates [voyageflow-overview::002]. Supported flight partners include Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak [voyageflow-overview::002]. VoyageFlow does not store real-time seat availability for flights [voyageflow-overview::002]. When a user confirms a plan, VoyageFlow generates a structured Booking Demand Card that includes a hotel search link pre-filled with destination, check-in/check-out dates, and guest count, as well as a flight search link pre-filled with origin/destination airports and travel dates [voyageflow-overview::003]. These links are deep-linked search URLs, not confirmed bookings, and users must complete their reservation on the destination platform [voyageflow-overview::003]. VoyageFlow does not act as a travel agent, an Online Travel Agency (OTA), or a merchant of record, and all transactions occur on partner platforms [voyageflow-overview::002]. VoyageFlow does not process payments directly; instead, it hands users off to trusted booking partners [voyageflow-overview::001].
